title: Health, damage, remaining
prompt: The robot reports a hit in three lines. Write three helpers: `print_health` prints the health, `print_damage` prints the damage, and `print_remaining` takes both and prints health minus damage. Call all three from `report_hit` in that order, so report_hit(100, 30) prints 100, 30, 70.
hints: Two helpers take one parameter; the last takes two.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
